Extract markdown-aware chunks and pass their content and metadata to your retrieval system.

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"text/markdown","uri":"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{"chunking":{"chunker_type":"markdown","max_characters":500,"overlap":50,"trim":true}}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extract(input, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].chunks);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
